summary: The team is pivoting its marketing weight behind the China-based Asia Star and Intelligent China programs while pushing the knowledge website redesign toward a merged final design and standing up the analytics needed to prove it all works.
summaryDetail: The top priority right now is the China-first promotion strategy: Asia Star and Intelligent China lead, Berkeley is a possible third, and the Stanford and Columbia US partnerships are parked for the first quarter — but this only pays off if conversion tracking is actually in place, so the tracking brief and the target-audience/CRM segmentation work (Joseph's document plus the participant-profile analysis) need to land this week to turn that decision into measurable campaigns. The knowledge website redesign is at a decision point: the team agreed to combine the best of both concepts, keep the two-menu Knowledge/School structure, and bring BCI/BSI indices onto the homepage — Joseph's HTML file and Joker's feedback-driven revisions are the gating items before the follow-up review. On the operational side, an Outlook lockout from stale credentials has eaten time and needs closing out via the new-password rollout and a CKGSB backend unlock confirmation. Looking ahead, the 2026 ESG and Social Innovation Report compilation is now a committed KPI, with Julie chasing missing department materials and Kaylee to formally invite Ms. Kanta Singh to the Women in Leadership Forum, while the Dutch entrepreneurs delegation lead still needs routing to Bo.
